notes: Sourced from VITEC's official datasheet (VITEC acquired Exterity; device chassis is branded "Exterity", VITEC is now the parent/publisher — manufacturer set to "Exterity" per the branding on the unit itself and product family name). Compact desktop/wall-mount unit (45mm H x 200mm L x 140mm D, 0.8kg) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Product photos show a rear panel with 2x RJ45, 2x USB-A, 1x HDMI out, and a DC barrel power jack, plus a separate 3.5mm jack (documented as an IR extender/tethered remote input). Network spec lists "2 x 1000BASE-T, 100BASE-TX and 10BASE-T" so both RJ45 ports graded eth-1g (top speed). HDMI v2.0 confirmed explicitly (up to 2160p60); device is output-only (no HDMI input — it's an IPTV decoder/media player, not a switcher). Audio ships embedded in HDMI (2ch PCM) — no separate analog/digital audio output port exists, so none was added. USB-A port count (2) confirmed via product photo, but USB version/speed is not stated in the datasheet text, so grade was omitted per instructions. The datasheet's Management section states "Access via SSH and Serial RS232 Admin Port" confirming a physical RS232 port exists, but its exact connector form factor isn't clearly visible in the available photography (could be a mini-jack breakout rather than a full DB9) — connector id "rs232" used as the closest/most literal match. A third-party retailer page (Avanta Digital) lists slightly different HDMI audio spec ("2 or 8 channel PCM or Bitstream", HDCP 1.4/2.2) not present in the manufacturer PDF (v1.3, 2022) — likely a newer firmware/revision note; not used here since the manufacturer datasheet was treated as authoritative.
